acceptanceCriteria.text: `npm audit --audit-level=moderate` on main reports no findings, or each remaining one is documented with why it cannot be fixed yet
`npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run coverage`, `npm run deadcode` and `npm run build` all pass after the upgrade
The PR CI `npm audit (fail on moderate+)` job passes

body:
The `npm audit (fail on moderate+)` check fails on every pull request, including ones that change no dependencies. On 2026-11-17, `npm audit` over main's own package-lock.json (main 9c4705d, v0.44.0) reports 15 high-severity findings: picomatch ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs, which reaches fdir/tinyglobby, vite, vitest and @vitest/coverage-v8, and ts-morph/@ts-morph/common, which reaches ts-prune. They were published after main's last green audit. Main's push CI does not run the audit job, so main still looks green.

This was found on PR #44 and PR #45 (SPACE scorecards), which only add a packaging-guard script line to package.json.

Upgrade or override the affected dev dependencies (`npm audit fix`, or targeted `overrides` for picomatch and fdir) without breaking vitest, coverage, ts-prune deadcode or the Fireguard suite.
title: Clear the high-severity npm audit findings that fail every PR
